proposal_title: Release Identity Alignment & Deterministic 4-Stage Hashing Pipeline
domain_specific_rationale: From a platform engineering and release distribution perspective, release integrity must be mathematically verifiable, deterministic, and free of circular self-referential hashing paradoxes. Forensic audit findings (FA-006 / TECH-011) identified that earlier freeze mechanisms attempted to hash manifest files that in turn recorded the overall bundle digest. CP-015 resolves this critical defect by establishing an explicit 4-stage deterministic hashing protocol: (1) calculate individual SHA-256 for all normative content files, (2) compute CONTENT_TREE_SHA256 from sorted 'relative_path\tsha256\n' strings excluding self-referential artifacts, (3) persist immutable manifest records (CONTENT_HASHES.json, FINAL_SPEC_MANIFEST.md, KIT_MANIFEST.yaml), and (4) archive the package into a distributable zip file with its corresponding DISTRIBUTABLE_ZIP_SHA256. Furthermore, it cryptographically anchors Council certification signatures to immutable raw voter ballot SHA-256 digests in C04R.

capability_impact: Guarantees absolute cryptographic provenance, auditability, and tamper-evident packaging for the entire specification freeze, protecting autonomous coding agent handoff and multi-repository downstream builds.
residual_risk: Operating system newline discrepancies (CRLF vs LF) or file sorting locales could cause tree hash mismatches during verification on non-POSIX platforms. Mitigated by binary-mode file reading and strict lexicographical UTF-8 byte sorting in verify_package.py.
